in_marathi.name: Sharanshak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of Path
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharanshak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharanshak is derived from the Sanskrit words Shara (protection) and Ansh (path). It means the protector of the path, one who guides and shields on the journey of life.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Protector of Path
